verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI-like feature is the "Describe your search" panel, which turns a plain-language description into an error search query. That is a narrow, single-purpose helper, not a general assistant you can hand tasks to. The MCP server lets external AI assistants use Honeybadger data, but that is not a built-in assistant, so it isn't credited here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant, the ability to delegate multi-step tasks (triage, resolve, investigate) inside the UI, explicit docs that the search panel is AI-powered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
